Usage: astryx experimental icon new-definition [options] <name>

[experimental] Add your icon set's own icon definition

Arguments:
  name                  The definition name, in camelCase (rocketLaunch) or kebab-case (rocket-launch)

Options:
  --dry-run             Validate and show planned writes without changing files
  --set <name>          The icon set to add it to, when the package ships several
  --description <text>  One sentence on what an icon with this definition is for
  --words <list>        Comma-separated words people search for
  --icon <id>           Also map it to this icon of the set (its `map` entry)
  -h, --help            display help for command

Exit codes:
  0  the definition is written or the dry run succeeds
  1  the name is invalid or taken, the description or words are missing, or the set or icon is not found

Examples:
  # Add a set's own icon definition
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 experimental icon new-definition random --description 'Pick something at random.' --words dice,shuffle,chance --icon dice-5

More: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs cli/commands/experimental-icon-new-definition
